authorization: User explicitly requested: can you run a tiny simulation to see if you get anything? This authorizes only this bounded experiment, superseding earlier no-training restriction for this side task.
ownership: Only P2_SIDE_01a09144_SIM_* files and data/generated/trained_data_response/p2_side_01a09144_tiny_01/. No main records, frozen inputs, maintained files, Git state or agents are touched.
decision_question: Does this one finite reference network show visible hidden activation displacement at physical t=40, compared with the tiny proven early-time lower bound?

model.loss: unhalved exact two-atom mean squared loss
model.initial_readout: actual independent finite Gaussian, not zero

primary_metric: sqrt(mean_{neuron,training atom} (h_l(t)-h_l(0))^2), l=1,2, with original neuron pairing
secondary_metrics: raw weight displacements Frobenius/sqrt(n), Frobenius, Euclidean/sqrt(n)
comparison: Same network at t=0 is the matched displacement baseline. No causal or frozen-feature superiority claim is tested.

diagnostic_thresholds.visible_both_layers: both final activation RMS displacements >=0.05 on tanh output scale
diagnostic_thresholds.otherwise: mixed/intermediate; report values without a broad conclusion

budget.reason_second: same initialization tighter solver tolerance, not replication or a width sweep
budget.branch_rule: No further runs; invalid checks make result inconclusive.

claim_scope: Exploratory finite width, one seed. No population limit, probability estimate, generic law claim, theorem correction or necessity/superiority of feature learning is inferred.
